Our Philosophy

Tradition Reimagined,
Served on the Go

Sourced from organic Japanese farms, our ceremonial matcha is masterfully whisked in small batches using traditional bamboo chasen. Combined with our house-made compotes, every pour offers an elevated, perfectly balanced beverage made for the moment.

"Luxury is not where you sit, but how deeply you savor the moment."

Single Origin Sourcing

Direct relationships with Uji and Nishio farms for the purest ceremonial grade.

The Origin

A Ritual in Motion

Velusa was born from a simple observation: while matcha is an ancient art, the modern experience often loses its soul in the rush. We set out to create something unprecedented—a luxury mobile pop-up dedicated entirely to the art of the perfect pour and fine artisan pairings.

Founded by Amara Kay, Velusa is built on a obsession with texture, balance, and patience. Every whisk, strain, and layer is designed to achieve our signature velvety finish, turning a simple beverage into a moment of pure calm.

We bring the elegance of a high-end tea house directly to your quiet mornings and vibrant gatherings. No shortcuts, no compromises—just pure, ceremonial grace in motion.

What We Stand For

🌱

Sustainability

Supporting sustainable agriculture by sourcing 100% organic ceremonial matcha and clean, thoughtfully selected ingredients.

🍵

Craftsmanship

Every cup is thoughtfully prepared using traditional Japanese techniques, whisked with a bamboo chasen for a silky, ceremonial finish.

🌸

Community

Supporting Kansas City's creative ecosystem through local pop-up collaborations, curated events, and community-driven drops.

The Mind Behind Velusa

Passionate about ceremonial matcha, artisanal pairings, and community.

AK

Amara Kay
